metadata.title: Likelihood-Ranked Selection in Self-Consuming Diffusion: A W2 Negative Result and a Narrow Minority-Retention Regime
metadata.description:
Workshop-scale empirical note. Primary: top-k likelihood selection does not improve sliced W2 vs random-k at generation 1 (38/38 cells; bootstrap CI excludes zero). Secondary: full bottom>rand>top minority retention strongest at moderate imbalance ρ=5 (exploratory n=10; held-out seeds 10–14). Weaker at ρ=7 and ρ=10. CIFAR-10 tiny-UNet is appendix preliminary only. Not shown on ImageNet-scale diffusion.

Code: https://github.com/muhammadalamzeb/likelihood-rank-self-consuming-diffusion
metadata.notes: Workshop-scope empirical note. Primary: top-k does not improve sliced W2 (n=38 cells). Secondary: narrow minority-retention regime at rho=5. CIFAR tiny-UNet appendix preliminary. Not ImageNet-scale.
